Visitor skips deeply nested elements

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_mark(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = "<div><p>Outer <em>emphasis <strong>with bold <mark>and highlight</mark></strong></em> text</p></div>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
